title: Suruga-ya Scraper
description: Scrape used hobby-goods prices from Suruga-ya (駿河屋), Japan's big second-hand store for figures, anime merchandise, games, and collectibles. Get used and new prices, stock status, product names, and images as clean JSON.

searchKeyword.title: Search Keyword
searchKeyword.description: Keyword to search for (Japanese characters supported)

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of search result pages to scrape (20 items per page)

inStockOnly.title: In Stock Only
inStockOnly.description: Only return items that are currently in stock

proxy.title: Proxy Configuration
proxy.description: Apify proxy configuration (uses Japan residential proxies by default)
